name: dc-cloud-status
_comment: Dispatch-inventory probe: which valve paths publish devices/{eui}/status to the cloud broker. A manual open, a one-time open and a 06:00 open, each on its own valve, with the cloud broker captured.

steps.why: Zone 1: a STREGA and a KIWI above threshold for the 06:00 tick. Zone 2 (no daily schedule): one STREGA for the manual open and one with a due ONCE schedule.
